summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce filed a Form 6-K incorporating an underwriting agreement for a US$500 million issuance of 6.750% Fixed Rate Reset Limited Recourse Capital Notes Series 10 (NVCC subordinated indebtedness), underwritten by CIBC World Markets Corp., Barclays Capital Inc., Citigroup Global Markets Inc., Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC, and Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The filing is a routine debt offering with no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The Notes are issued under a base indenture and fourth supplemental indenture with standard terms. This is an ordinary capital markets transaction, not a special situation event.
